overview.title: Overview Dashboard
overview.purpose: At-a-glance status of all channels, pipeline, approvals, quota, usage and alerts.
overview.empty: No channels yet. Start with Channel Discovery or add an existing channel.

discovery.title: Channel Discovery
discovery.purpose: Run niche discovery and compare opportunity candidates with transparent scores and evidence.
discovery.empty: No discovery reports yet. Scores use permitted public sources only — never aggregated YouTube data (ADR-0015).

channels.title: Channel Manager
channels.purpose: List and manage all channels: state, mode, private-only, token health, caps.
channels.empty: No channels yet. Create one from a blueprint or add an existing channel.

onboarding.title: Channel Onboarding
onboarding.purpose: Guided manual channel creation, Google Cloud/OAuth setup, connection, identity confirmation and test upload.
onboarding.empty: Onboarding always has steps — this list should never be empty.

niche.title: Niche Research
niche.purpose: Deep dive into one niche: evidence, sources, audience notes, risks, keyword evidence.
niche.empty: No evidence for this niche. Re-run the analysis.

trends.title: Trend Intelligence
trends.purpose: Rising topics per channel from permitted sources, with expiry and confidence.
trends.empty: No trends yet. Run a scan; only sources enabled in Settings › Research sources are used.

lookup.title: Competitor Research
lookup.purpose: Owner-initiated lookup of ONE public channel/video at a time (Developer-Policy compliant, ADR-0015).
lookup.empty: No lookups yet. Look up one public channel or video at a time — for example a channel handle or a video link.

branding.title: Channel Branding Studio
branding.purpose: View/edit the channel blueprint (names, description, brand identity, logo/banner briefs, positioning, audience, pillars, formats, 30-day calendar, 50 ideas, risks).
branding.empty: The blueprint is being generated. Sections appear here as they finish.

ideas.title: Idea Generator
ideas.purpose: Backlog of ideas with similarity warnings; generate, edit, shortlist, approve.
ideas.empty: No ideas yet. Generate ideas from your blueprint or add your own.

calendar.title: Content Calendar
calendar.purpose: Month/week view of planned ideas, projects in production and scheduled releases across channels.
calendar.empty: This month is empty. Drag shortlisted ideas here.

script.title: Script Studio
script.purpose: Edit AI-drafted script with versions, fact-check results and owner value-add fields.
script.empty: No script yet. Start scripting from the approved research.

storyboard.title: Storyboard Studio
storyboard.purpose: Scene list with narration, visual instruction, on-screen text, durations.

studio.title: AI Video Studio
studio.purpose: Timeline editor with proxy preview; assemble, adjust, approve rough cut.

visuals.title: Image & Visual Asset Studio
visuals.purpose: Create/assign visuals per scene: procedural graphics, charts, kinetic text, owner media, CC0, stock import.
visuals.empty: No visuals yet. Start from a template.

voice.title: Voiceover Studio
voice.purpose: Produce narration per scene: record own voice, use own voice clone, or licensed TTS; manage voice profiles.
voice.empty: No narration yet. Record your own voice (recommended) or generate it.

thumbnails.title: Thumbnail Creator
thumbnails.purpose: Generate/upload ≥3 thumbnails, check them, compare side by side, select.

seo.title: YouTube SEO Studio
seo.purpose: Titles, description, tags, hashtags, chapters, playlists, language, made-for-kids (owner), AI disclosure.

captions.title: Caption & Subtitle Manager
captions.purpose: Generate, edit and review caption tracks per language.

renders.title: Render Manager
renders.purpose: All proxy/final render jobs with progress, QC reports and resource waits.

uploads.title: Upload Manager
uploads.purpose: Upload jobs with step-by-step progress (transfer, thumbnail, captions, playlist, processing), quota and retries.

schedule.title: Publishing Scheduler
schedule.purpose: See and adjust scheduled releases (private + publishAt), respecting caps and quiet hours.

approvals.title: Owner Approval Center
approvals.purpose: All pending decisions in one place with full context and hash-bound approval.
approvals.empty: All caught up — no pending approvals.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.purpose: Own-channel performance over time (views, engaged views, watch time, AVD, CTR, subs) per channel and video.
analytics.empty: No analytics yet. Data appears about 48 hours after your first publish.

growth.title: Growth & Optimization Center
growth.purpose: Data-backed suggestions (topics, hooks, length, upload time) and comment moderation assistant — owner decides.
growth.empty: No suggestions yet. They need at least 3 published videos with 7 days of data.

assets.title: Asset Library
assets.purpose: All media with rights status; upload, set rights, manual stock import, free stock search, paid purchase (optional).
assets.empty: The library is empty. Upload your own media or import free stock.

usage.title: Cost & Usage Manager
usage.purpose: Every provider's usage vs limit, YouTube quota buckets, stock/paid budgets, disk usage; provider enable/verify; paid activation.

notifications.title: Notification Center
notifications.purpose: Inbox of notifications; preferences per event × channel; targets setup (Telegram, email); delivery tracking.

agents.title: AI Agent Control Center
agents.purpose: All 32 agents: status, config, limits, runs, errors; pause via kill switch.

policy.title: Copyright & Policy Center
policy.purpose: All audit reports across projects; blocked items; overrides; policy reference.

security.title: Audit & Security Center
security.purpose: Audit log (hash-chain verified), security events, security posture checklist, sessions.

settings.title: Settings & Integrations
settings.purpose: System settings, Google Cloud/OAuth clients, research sources, AI providers shortcuts, notifications targets, backups, account & 2FA, about/versions.
